title: Sofa cover
text: Sofa cover. My velvety sofa cover is perfect for my needs!  Soft and most importantly non slip!  Got so tired of trying to keep a throw cover from falling every time I got up.  This is a great cover - will probably order another for my recliner…

product_metadata.title: TEWENE Sofa Cover, Velvet Couch Cover Anti-Slip Sectional Couch Covers Sofa Slipcover for Dogs Cats Pet Love Seat Armrest Backrest Cover Coffee 28''x28'' (Only 2 Pieces/Not All Set)
features: [2 Pcs 28''x28''/NOT ALL SET]: TEWENE sofa covers are made of high-quality fabric with a little velvet which is soft and smooth to the touch and not easy to collect hair or pets fur.(Sold by PIECE, Not All Set)

[ANTI-SLIP DESIGN]: TEWENE couch covers has improved Anti-Slip backing silicon rubber design; The enhanced and exquisite version of the corner stitching still keeps the sofa cover firm after washing; Environmentally friendly printing and dyeing process makes the sectinal couch cover not easy to fade.

[EASY INSTALLATION&CARE]: TEWENE sectional sofa cover works great on both fabric and leather furniture and is easy to set up! No Other Accessories Needed! Easy to clean, machine wash (cold) and dry (cool), Do Not Bleach.

[MULTIPLE FUNCTION&APPLICATION]: Protect your couch, sofa, loveseat, recliner and chairs from pets, spills, stains. The couch covers are suitable for all seasons and not only used for sofa cover, but also for baby play mat, bedroom rug, floor pad, window bench mat etc...

[Tips]: Please kindly measure your sofa before purchasing, the size of sofa cover usually larger than the size of the sofa to tuck the sofa cover in the back and front of the couch more to hold in place. Any problems with the size selection and the quality, please don't hesitate to contact us. TEWENE are always here for helping service.
